description: This file defines the Averages class with static methods for statistical calculations such as average deviations, mean, median, mode, and averagea, within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

classes.name: Averages
classes.description: A class providing static methods for statistical averages calculations in PhpSpreadsheet.

methods.name: averageDeviations
methods.description: Calculates the average of the absolute deviations of data points from their mean.

methods.name: average
methods.description: Calculates the arithmetic mean of given values.

methods.name: averageA
methods.description: Calculates the average including numbers, text, and logical values.

methods.name: median
methods.description: Returns the median value of the given numbers.

methods.name: mode
methods.description: Returns the most frequently occurring value in a set of data.
